To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the genome of A. ferroxidans ATCC 33270 was sequenced, (ii) it contains a large number of genes involved in sulfur oxidation, (iii) a large number of these genes are clustered in the genome, and (iv) this clustering is likely to be the result of horizontal gene transfer from a bacterium that was a sulfur oxidizing ancestor of A. feroxidans
we have sequenced, annotated and analyzed the genome of the acidophile A. ferro oxidans ATCC23270.

the type strain of Acidithiobacillius ferrooxidans has a 2.9-Mb genome, which contains genes for all major pathways of central metabolism and for many stress response systems, but lacks a complete set of genes for nitrogen fixation, which has been reported for other strains of A. ferroxidans.

the development of an integrated metabolic model of A. ferrodioxidans and its application to the design of improved biomining strategies.

the reconstruction of the metabolic networks in A. ferro oxidans, which will help us to identify new genes and metabolic pathways, and provide a platform for the development of new biotechnology and biomining applications.
the development and application of bioinformatics methods for the analysis of bacterial genomes.
